bio: Baptized 3 May 1806 (Gortnahoe), son of Humphrey Heffernan and Anastasia Ryan; married Anastasia Boney at Gortnahoe 12 Feb 1827; lived at Mardyke; died in Ireland. Baptisms of their children name 'Dick Heffernan and Anty Boney' (Dwyer Branch 3).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh

handoff.section: 3.3 Pringle, Heffernan and the Pennsylvania lines (with Irish, Palatine German and French Huguenot roots)
